en_US.title: Riskier Contract Seeds
en_US.scanner: You can choose a worse contract, not a stronger body.
en_US.field_note: Replay should ask for greed, courage or stupidity, not grind.
en_US.terminal: CONTRACT SEED OPTION: higher lien relief, deeper initial target, worse weather window, stricter evidence custody or rarer resource requirement. No equipment power carryover.
en_US.audio: The board pays more when it expects less of you to return.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Riskier contract seeds let experienced players change pressure without changing canon. A run can start with worse orbital timing, deeper early objectives or harsher custody terms. The player chooses risk, not inherited strength.
en_US.external_site: Riskier Contract Seeds make replayability economic and procedural: the contract changes the ocean's demands.

ru_RU.title: Более рискованные контрактные seeds
ru_RU.scanner: Можно выбрать худший контракт, а не более сильное тело.
ru_RU.field_note: Replay должен просить жадность, смелость или глупость, а не grind.
ru_RU.terminal: CONTRACT SEED OPTION: higher lien relief, deeper initial target, worse weather window, stricter evidence custody or rarer resource requirement. No equipment power carryover.
ru_RU.audio: Доска платит больше, когда ожидает меньше возвратов.
ru_RU.in_game_wiki: Более рискованные contract seeds позволяют опытным игрокам менять давление без изменения канона. Забег может начинаться с хуже orbital timing, более глубоких ранних целей или жестких custody terms. Игрок выбирает риск, а не унаследованную силу.
ru_RU.external_site: Более рискованные контрактные seeds делают replayability экономическим и процедурным: контракт меняет требования океана.

en_US.title: False Ending Count Ladder
en_US.scanner: Four major false families before the deep Atlas resolutions.
en_US.field_note: Enough endings to reward playstyles. Not so many that the truth becomes noise.
en_US.terminal: ENDING LADDER: material payout, partial exit/return, corporate capture/quarantine and public ledger leak form the major false/partial families before Atlas basin payload resolutions.
en_US.audio: The dossier can mark many exits before it marks an answer.
en_US.in_game_wiki: HECTON-8 should support multiple outcomes without dissolving into random endings. A practical target is four major false/partial families before the true deep endings: material, partial return, corporate/quarantine and public ledger. Each is real, replayable and incomplete.
en_US.external_site: False Ending Count Ladder controls scope: many exits, few clear families, and deep Atlas endings as the campaign's gravity center.

ru_RU.title: Лестница ложных концовок
ru_RU.scanner: Четыре основные false families до глубоких Atlas resolutions.
ru_RU.field_note: Достаточно концовок для разных стилей. Не настолько много, чтобы правда стала шумом.
ru_RU.terminal: ENDING LADDER: material payout, partial exit/return, corporate capture/quarantine and public ledger leak form the major false/partial families before Atlas basin payload resolutions.
ru_RU.audio: Dossier может отметить много выходов до того, как отметит ответ.
ru_RU.in_game_wiki: HECTON-8 должен поддерживать множество outcomes, но не распадаться на случайные endings. Практическая цель - четыре основные false/partial families до настоящих глубоких концовок: material, partial return, corporate/quarantine и public ledger. Каждая реальна, replayable и неполна.
ru_RU.external_site: Лестница ложных концовок контролирует масштаб: много выходов, несколько ясных семей и глубокие Atlas endings как центр кампании.

en_US.title: Dossier Knowledge Not Power
en_US.scanner: No inherited oxygen, guns, hull, or magic shortcuts.
en_US.field_note: The player can become wiser. The ocean should not become smaller.
en_US.terminal: META RULE: Dossier records may unlock warnings, rumor families, claim variants and ending context. It must not preserve equipment power, resource inventory, world truth ownership or route authority.
en_US.audio: Memory does not reinforce a cracked hull.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Dossier persistence must protect the game's mood. Keeping power would turn pressure into a solved problem. Keeping knowledge lets players recognize lies earlier, choose riskier contracts and understand consequences while still respecting each new seed.
en_US.external_site: Dossier Knowledge Not Power is the replayability rule that keeps HECTON-8 long-form and dangerous.
